general_law.population: FT2-10 complete neutral-lifecycle serial population, including all governed sessions and structural WAIT/PENDING/OCCUPIED rows

relative_capture_tripwire.selected_arm: the composer alpha arm proposed for the applicable freeze
relative_capture_tripwire.control_arm: alpha=0.0 no-screen arm with the same model, k, calibrators, physical/safety masks, action gate, serial state machine, sessions, seed or ensemble, and fee trajectory
relative_capture_tripwire.big_win_definition: FT2-04 v2 remaining-session MFE fee-adjusted return on entry premium is at least +0.40 for a successfully filled serial entry

primary_metric.name: big_win_incidence_per_governed_session
primary_metric.formula: number of successfully filled entries meeting big_win_definition divided by all governed sessions

required_secondary_reports.big_win_opportunity_dollars_per_governed: sum max(0,remaining-session MFE fee-adjusted dollars) for big-win entries divided by all governed sessions
required_secondary_reports.positive_neutral_lifecycle_PnL_concentra: sum max(0,neutral-lifecycle PnL dollars) for big-win-path entries divided by sum max(0,neutral-lifecycle PnL dollars) for all entries
required_secondary_reports.relative_ratios: selected divided by alpha0 for each secondary metric

uncertainty.report: point ratio plus conservative session-cluster 95% interval for each primary and secondary relative metric
uncertainty.trigger_uses: the frozen point relative-capture rule; intervals describe uncertainty and cannot suppress a point breach

relative_capture_tripwire.scope: Every serious candidate, fold, seed, frozen ensemble, fee trajectory, and no-bid sensitivity convention.

four_bucket_profile_tripwire.evaluation_unit: successfully filled serial trade under the applicable complete policy ledger
four_bucket_profile_tripwire.return_definition: fee-adjusted neutral-lifecycle net PnL divided by entry premium at risk
required_reports: count and share in every bucket
conservative session-cluster 95% interval for every share
mean and median return within every bucket
share of positive PnL from big wins
side, phase, premium-band, and volatility-regime breakdown

big_loss.basis: two times the Charter's approximately 2% big-loss ceiling

big_win_near_zero.basis: the signed D50 near-zero definition retained as an absolute profile alarm; relative capture is evaluated separately and is stricter when alpha0 has a material tail

four_bucket_profile_tripwire.relationship_to_relative_capture: Both tripwires are evaluated independently at every freeze gate. Passing the absolute profile never overrides a relative-capture breach, and passing relative capture never overrides a four-bucket breach.

harvest_ratio_tripwire.evaluation_entries: identical frozen entries for floor-on and learned-exit-without-floor
harvest_ratio_tripwire.eligible_trade: causal peak available fee-adjusted PnL before forced flat is strictly positive
harvest_ratio_tripwire.aggregate: sum realized fee-adjusted PnL over eligible trades divided by sum peak available fee-adjusted PnL over eligible trades
collapse_all_required: floor-on ratio falls by at least 0.10
floor-on divided by floor-off is strictly below 0.75
conservative session-cluster upper confidence bound for floor-on minus floor-off is below zero

tripwire_cannot_rescue: G4, daily-stop, soft-close, or ruin failure

census_v2_context.role: Design context only. Census paths neither pass nor fail a candidate tripwire.
